scope: Full static source/interface review of the initial complete script and each final revision. No audit-script execution or import; no native/GT/return/vector decode, numerical result calculation or large data hashing. Only source text, frozen administrative JSON and source SHA were inspected.
resolved_findings: Evaluator provenance must now contain every role GT/source-row path, original M5 posting/TRAIN support, every point receipt and all raw files; their bounded current hashes must match. Extra auxiliary code/CSV/summary sources may be absent from evaluator provenance.
Query provenance must match frozen query SHA; current query/base/index identity remains administrative preflight plus current stat closure, without decoding or hashing vectors in this audit.
Independent audit now records its own source SHA.

Final revisions bind full M5/extension commits and original R/C scalar fees to full trace; sampled per-query graph scalar increments and full/sample graph-slot classifications are checked without claiming full main NDC.
administrative_gate_checks: Before any GT or saved return is decoded: native-complete status, active=None, four unique role/dataset exits0, observed1 thread and 112/336/0-fit scope are required.
Protocol/jobs/source/binary SHA and actual input stats are bound; original preflight, preexecution and full native source-review gates are required.

All four frozen actual configs, formal job completion receipts, fixed method rotation, 112 point receipts and336 positive timed rows are inspected before GT decoding. Native query-call accounting matches warm256 + timed3n + plainn + replayn + count256 per point.
Source hashes are refused above64MiB; source-and-binary lock contains bounded sources/binary, while base/index/query values remain stat-only in the independent script.
schema_and_integer_checks: Role confirmation GT is raw little-endian int32,4096x100; original frozen TRAIN GT support is little-endian int64,20000x100. The stdlib array parser checks ABI size, exact bytes and endian conversion.

Original posting magic/header/layout agrees with runtime:40-byte header +45H +8hash_n, H includes empty rows, b8, counts and target padding validated. ID unions do not substitute for per-query routes or training performance.

Saved ID/score/profile/route/count arrays have exact frozen lengths. Score f32 words are decoded only as saved values; no distance is generated. IDs are unique/in-domain with exact FLT_MAX padding and sorted lower-is-better scores.
Independent set membership and Python integer rank-bit masks reconstruct112 hit totals; Recall denominators use each actual K, rescue-damage equals query and total integer quality differences.

All3 complete-wall QPS values are recomputed as n/wall. The288 comparison keys match evaluator generation, same-L sequential KL rounds and cross-L round-index-only scope; separation/faster/joint flags match declared finite formulas.

JSON/CSV list/dict/bool/int/float conversion matches evaluator serializer. Required CSV presence, exact row counts, unique keys, fields, source files and missing-source keys fail; output is created only after successful checks.
trace_and_fee_checks: All64 region points, including16 primary M5REG96 points, use exact128-int32 layout seed3/nC/nX/nSeeds/commit/abort/C24/X96 with padding/cap/domain/unique/disjoint validation.
Original C arrival/prefix is independently reconstructed from posting rows and original GT-main R; complete successful C and empty/failure fallback identities match region.hpp.

M5 extension new true rescues must arise from X; aborted M5 X keeps exact original M5 ID/score packet. Returned support, table/TRAIN outside-support incidence, C/X truth coverage and target-rank buckets are kept separate.

Full untimed region trace scores are not serialized. Seed minimum and ordered graph/visited X generation are deliberately inherited from the prior full native scalar oracle, not claimed as independently recomputed here.

Full trace new scalar/seed/abort/commit counts, finite-stage original R+C dots and trace histograms match full replay summaries. Failed X scalar is included in nx/fees while extension commit is excluded.

Fixed256 count rows check post R+C and X scalar increments against GT-main graph count; every graph slot equals one new scalar or one of four skip classes. Full region slot counts are distinct from unmeasured full main NDC.
uncertainty_and_limits: Bootstrap seed/count/scope and finite ordered endpoints plus CSV/JSON identity are checked; stochastic numerical CI endpoints are explicitly not independently regenerated.
Three round ratios and pointwise descriptive intervals across many comparisons establish no simultaneous/general dominance or default replacement.
Saved full plain/replay receipts are bound; timed outputs were not retained and are not independently word-audited by this script.
Source review is not actual script execution, complete native success, result audit acceptance or performance evidence. Empirical state remains PENDING.
No distance/search/fit/teacher/graph/GT generation is introduced; no new metric, role or parameter selection is introduced.
